16. To find out the remainder of the Dasa operating at the
time of birth, first find out the cxpized portion of the Dasa of
the concerned planet. This is done 8७ follows. Multiply the
Dasa period of 1! nlanet concerned py the period of the stay
of the Moonin tne Janma Nakslsira that has expired and
Ajvids it by the total period of the stay of the Moon in that
+ akshatra, The figure in years, months etc. so arrived ai ill
be the expired period of the Dasa Hf this figure is deducte:
from the total period of the Dasa, we will get the balance of
, Dasa at the time of birth.

Example ; Suppose the birth has taken place in Mrigasira
Nakshatra. The lord of the Dasa operating at birth will, there-
fore, be Mars. The expired period (stata) of Mrigasira is 58/15
(58 ghatis and 15 palas) or 3415 Palas. The total period (भ्रभोग)
of Mrigasira is 59/31 (S59 ghatis and 31 palas) or 3571 palas
3415 multiplied by 7 years (Dasa period of Mars) comes to
24435. This divided by 3577 will give the expired period of
Dasa as 6/10/6/22/5 (6 years, 10 months, 6 day, 22 ghatikas and
5 palas). By deducting this from 7 years, we will get the balance
of Dasa at birth as 0/1/23/37/55 (1 month, 23 days, 37 ghatis-
and 55 99185).

Notes ; The above method is based on Panchangas. Modern
researchers in Astrology have devised a much simpler method to
